brief:
**BLUF:** Veterans Day events and recognitions continue across Tazewell County, VA, and Mercer County, WV, including parades, museum honors, and community celebrations in Tazewell, Princeton, and Bluefield. Bluefield (WV) City Manager Cecil Marson is departing for a new position in Texas, and the city approved an ordinance merging its storm water and sanitary boards. No active NWS alerts or major law enforcement, fire, or hazard incidents reported in the core area in the last 24 hours; mild weather brings rain today with cooler temperatures and a chance of snow overnight.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/video/2026/11/10/bluefield-city-manager-cecil-marson-leaving-new-job/)[[2]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for closures, outages, or incidents. Weather in the core (Tazewell/Bluefield area): Mostly cloudy with rain mainly this morning; highs in the upper 40s falling to the lower 40s; west winds 10-15 mph with gusts to 30 mph. Tonight: Mostly cloudy with chance of rain, chance of snow after midnight (little or no accumulation); lows in the lower 30s; northwest winds 10-15 mph with gusts to 30 mph. No active NWS alerts.[[3]](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/now/bluefield-wv-24701)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Bluefield (WV) City Council approved an ordinance merging the city’s storm water and sanitary boards. Mercer County Commission recognized former Oakvale Town Council member Randolph Brown Honaker with two proclamations and honored him with a resolution. Bluefield (WV) City Manager Cecil Marson is leaving for a new position in Texas.[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/video/2026/11/10/two-charged-attempted-scam-giles-county/)

Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on the challenge to Virginia’s abortion/reproductive freedom amendment (Ballot Question 1) rescheduled to November 24 before Judge Jack Hurley; the Founding Freedoms Law Center seeks a preliminary injunction against certification.[[5]](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/lawsuit-challenges-virginia-abortion-amendment-in-tazewell/id6785089136?i=1000801269477&l=fr-FR)

**Region:** Cardinal News reported on calls for Southwest Virginia to receive a seat on the Court of Appeals.[[2]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Bluefield Alumnae Chapter (Delta Sigma Theta) to donate more than 500 food items to Union Mission. Mercer County Veterans Museum held events honoring veterans for Veterans Day. Community celebrations of Veterans Day occurred in Princeton (Mercer County, WV), with people of all ages participating. Bluefield University introduced the “Bluefield Promise” tuition-free pathway for qualifying Virginia students (including from Tazewell, Bland, Giles, and Wythe counties) starting with the class of 2027.[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/06/bluefield-university-introduces-bluefield-promise/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on abortion amendment challenge: November 24.
- Ongoing Veterans Day-related community events and recognitions in the core area.
- Weather: Chance of snow possible overnight into Friday; monitor for any travel impacts. No other scheduled items or developing hazards noted.
